status: synthetic mature-vintage counterfactual, not real historical signing ledger or future NFL prediction

assumptions.rookieSalary: 100/125/150 from Y1 at sign; different guarantee variants
assumptions.vintages: active 2027 old rookies follow NFL experience 1–3; veterans assigned deterministic staggered 2025–27 vintages
assumptions.anchor2027: annual 2027 player cost exactly matches CP6k post-draft ownership, historic signing prices synthesized by inverting contract factor
assumptions.marketCap: CP6k top120/6, rookie salary contaminates pure market value; market shocks 0,-10,-20% annually from 2028
assumptions.marketCapFeedback: prior season shocked realized cap drives next year minimum and rookie initial contract salary
assumptions.initialPriorDead: none — no invented pre-2027 cut events; 2027 roster not built using contract expiry signals
assumptions.actions: 2028–31 draft 5 signed rookies/team, provisional renewals at expiry (free decline), otherwise financially relevant cuts and roster-limited unowned FA with 3Y salaries
assumptions.capCheck: only annual pre-season check; no weekly payroll or in-season enforcement tested
assumptions.market: no player trades, buyer claims, asset market, salary retention, IR/Taxi or full 30-slot current Sleeper implementation
assumptions.objective: six-team budget/13-starter coverage under 20–40-occupancy candidate, not title or global optimal management

validation.executable: V8 interpreter of exact source functions
